title: Canonical coefficient dual tensor internal-Hom evaluation comparison
statement: Let $B$ be a category with independent object and morphism universes, $H:B^{op}\times B\to B$ a bifunctor, and $S$ a closed tensor-Hom structure for $H$ as in [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Write $\otimes$, $\mathbf1$, $\alpha$, $\rho$, and $\mathrm{ev}_{P,O}:H(P,O)\otimes P\to O$ for its tensor, unit, associator, right unitor, and adjunction evaluation. Let $s$ be a symmetry for this monoidal structure, let $O\in B$, and let $u:\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\sim}O$. For arbitrary $P,N\in B$, define $d_{P,N}:N\otimes H(P,O)\to H(P,N)$ to be the transpose under $-\otimes P\dashv H(P,-)$ of $(N\otimes H(P,O))\otimes P\xrightarrow{\alpha}N\otimes(H(P,O)\otimes P)\xrightarrow{1\otimes\mathrm{ev}_{P,O}}N\otimes O\xrightarrow{1\otimes u^{-1}}N\otimes\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\rho}N$. Define $c_{P,N}:H(P,O)\otimes N\to H(P,N)$ by first applying $s_{H(P,O),N}$ and then $d_{P,N}$. In the coefficient-unit case take $O=\mathbf1$ and $u=1$. These definitions impose no perfectness, invertibility of either comparison, orientation, or exceptional inverse-image hypothesis.
